48.original: In accordance with protocol introduced by the flea-infested manager, the Last Dregs' water supply is currently sourced directly from the wellspring of regret.

49.original: As organic life-forms have a tendency to succumb to even minor environmental fluctuations, regular analysis and maintenance of the water supply is imperative to prevent widespread demise of café patrons.

50.original: Appropriate sample for analysis detected. Approximate coordinates: 13, 16, 2. Harmful agents can seep into solid stone, indicating current levels of environmental toxicity. Speedy completion of task objectives is highly recommended.

51.original: Appropriate sample for analysis detected. Approximate coordinates: 13, 14, 2. Harmful agents often seep into the soil, indicating current levels of environmental toxicity. Speedy completion of task objectives is highly recommended.

52.original: Appropriate sample for analysis detected. Approximate coordinates: 14, 11, 2. Resident fauna can be analyzed for harmful agents, indicating current levels of toxicity. Gold salmon roe, available for purchase from N<hex:021F0103>0598, is estimated to further expediency of completing task objectives.

53.original: Repeating task objectives: proceed to coordinates 13, 16, 2 and obtain requested sample. Every idle moment exacerbates potential corruption of the Last Dregs' water supply.

56.original: Return of allied courier <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> confirmed. Requesting detailed report with deliverables.

57.original: Analyzing delivered materials... In accordance with pan-galactic sanitation standards, the purity level of the water source has received a grade of B.

58.original: In contrast, Alphatron water can be instantly synthesized to exceed a grade of A by all accepted standards. The foul-smelling manager's insistence on “natural” water is conclusively illogical.

59.original: However, so long as its provision does not hinder current work objectives, B-grade water meets minimum safety standards. Receive your recompense for this task and await future instructions, perhaps while imbibing some technically nontoxic liquids.
